What To Know Before You Apply
Ready to apply?
Please see the below instructions on how to successfully apply to the Graduate School of Biomedical Sciences (GSBS):
When you select apply now, you’ll be routed to our online application which is housed by our application vendor Element451.
All GSBS degree and certificate program applications are hosted on this site.
You will be asked to create an account.
Please note you may apply to multiple programs in the same cycle, but will need to complete an application and upload materials for each separately. Materials cannot be shared.
A couple things to keep in mind:
Starting 9/01/24 a $50 nonrefundable administrative processing fee will be assessed in the GSBS application for applicants that require Visa Sponsorship. This fee must be paid via the Element451 application with a credit card. We cannot accept cash, check, or money order.
For the application process, all documents uploaded into your application are considered unofficial. Therefore we recommend uploading unofficial transcripts and scores only.
If your GPA is not on a 4.0 scale you will need to convert it using a GPA conversion calculator such as WES iGPA, and then upload the unofficial document showing how you came up with that number.

UT San Antonio Health Science Center is the academic health center of The University of Texas at San Antonio. It includes schools of medicine, dentistry, nursing, health professions, graduate biomedical sciences and public health, and a clinical enterprise called UT Health San Antonio, which conducts 2.5 million patient visits yearly.
